clue.text: Where fruit is cultivated, park keeper cutting only borders

indicators.note: the warden cuts into the pair of edge letters, sitting between them
the borders of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a ranger looks after a national park or forest

explanation.surface: A park warden pruning only the edges of the fruit garden.
explanation.definitionFit: An orangery is a glasshouse built for growing citrus trees, a place where fruit is raised.

clue.text: Catch alight

definitions.meaning: to ... a fish is to catch it
to come down to earth, as a bird or plane touches down

explanation.definitionFit: Both are verb senses: hauling in a fish, and settling on the ground after flight.

clue.text: Plant — point in shrub so unusual

indicators.note: the compass letter is placed inside the rearranged letters
unusual means the letters of the two words appear in an odd order

parts.note: E (east) is a compass point

explanation.surface: A gardener notes a plant has an oddly placed growing point in its shrub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges SHRUBSO into ROSBUSH, and 'in' puts E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose bush is a shrub, so it is an example of a plant.

clue.text: Part of the body, the bottom!

definitions.meaning: the limb end we stand on
the lowest part, as at the base of a hill or page

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names the limb end we walk on and the base or lowest end of something.

clue.text: Sort of party people in state of inertia

parts.note: a stag party is a groom's night out before his wedding
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A sluggish crowd at a bachelor party.
explanation.walkthrough: A stag party (a stag night) is the British name for a groom's pre-wedding celebration with friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagnation is a lack of movement or development, a condition of inactivity.

clue.text: A key to get out?

definitions.meaning: the Esc key on a computer keyboard

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the keyboard button marked Esc; the other is the verb meaning to break free.

clue.text: Gift, almost all wrapped in canvas?

indicators.note: the shortened word is enclosed by the shelter

parts.note: a tent is made of canvas, so canvas can mean a tent

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of all is dropped

explanation.surface: A present nearly fully wrapped in canvas rather than paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gift' looks like the thing being wrapped, but it is the definition; 'canvas' stands for a tent by material.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift is a natural ability, the same as a flair or aptitude.

clue.text: Fool had endured drunk

indicators.note: drunk means the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A fool who has put up with being intoxicated.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunderhead is a stupid person, a blockhead or idiot.

clue.text: Great photo on end of mantelpiece

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of mantelpiece

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a photo

explanation.surface: A great photo placed on the end of the mantelpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: Epic, as an adjective, means very impressive or grand in scale.

clue.text: Second worker shot in court

parts.note: to second a proposal is to back it
a hand is a labourer, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: Another labourer gunned down in a courtroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot in court' is a tennis stroke, not a shooting at a trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A backhand is a tennis stroke played with the back of the hand facing the ball, on a court.

clue.text: Minute can last for eternity

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: last for picks the final letter of eternity

explanation.surface: Whether a minute can endure for ever.
explanation.definitionFit: Minute, pronounced my-NEWT, means extremely small.

clue.text: Check hole for design again

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain
a vent is an opening or hole

explanation.surface: An inspector checks a gap before redesigning it.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinvent something is to create it anew, devising it afresh.

clue.text: Giant monster Goliath swallows up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters read from bottom to top
the two words swallow a run of letters across their junction

explanation.surface: A huge monster gulping down the biblical giant Goliath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swallows' finds ERGO across monster Goliath, and 'up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogre is a fairy-tale giant who eats people.

clue.text: Primate fences off southern part of the church

indicators.note: the animal surrounds the letter as a fence encloses land

parts.note: an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A monkey cordons off the south end of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is the rounded recess at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Gag for a sweet?

definitions.meaning: read as a mouth stopper, a thing that silences someone; gob is slang for mouth
a large, hard, long-lasting round candy

explanation.walkthrough: Gob is British slang for mouth, so the word literally means a mouth plug.
explanation.definitionFit: A gobstopper is a big hard boiled candy, and taken literally a thing plugging the mouth.

clue.text: Leave job — or renew contract?

explanation.definitionFit: Quitting a post is one sense; read with a hyphen, re-sign means putting a name to a deal once more.

clue.text: After rioting, San Diego suffered greatly

indicators.note: rioting means the letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A Californian city in great distress after civil unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: To have agonised is to have endured great anguish or torment.

clue.text: Set off from school in the day

indicators.note: the school goes inside the calendar word

parts.note: a date is a particular day
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.walkthrough: Eton is an elite English boarding school; 'Set off' means trigger, not depart.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off a bomb is to make it explode.

clue.text: Possible cause of downfall, crazy family

parts.note: bananas is slang for mad
kin are relatives

explanation.surface: A mad family might bring about someone's ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipping on a discarded fruit peel is the classic comic fall, and figuratively a pitfall.

clue.text: Late qualifying round, closest possible result

parts.note: the late person is a dead one
a heat is a preliminary race

explanation.surface: A late qualifying race ends in the tightest finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead heat is a race finish in which competitors tie exactly.

clue.text: First of sonnets is written up in law, poetical analysis

indicators.note: First of picks the opening letter of sonnets
the turned word goes inside the word for law

parts.note: a canon is a law or rule, especially of the church

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the two letters read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A sonnet's opening line is written into law as a study of poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'written up' means reading upward; 'law' here is a canon, a church rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Scansion is the analysis of a poem's metre and rhythm.

clue.text: Sherpa composed a few words

indicators.note: composed means the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A Himalayan guide wrote a few words.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase is a small group of words forming a unit.

clue.text: Some big American match

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.definitionFit: A game is a sporting contest, the same as a fixture or bout.

clue.text: Change something affected by the moon rising

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: the sea's tide is pulled by the moon

explanation.surface: Something altered by the moon coming up.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit a text is to alter or revise it.
